newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo chairman wants Gyll on board.
newsitem.headline: Volvo chairman wants Gyll on board.

text.p: The chairman of AB Volvo, Bert-Olof Svanholm, said on Monday he wanted outgoing chief executive Soren Gyll to stay on the company's board, among other things to protect Volvo's interest in drug company Pharmacia-Upjohn.
Gyll, who is to leave his executive position after five years at the end of April, is a member of P&U's board.
"I have spoken with the nomination committee...about keeping Soren on the board," Svanholm told a news conference.
"It is important that we look after our interests on the board of Pharmacia & Upjohn, not least after what has happened."
P&U's managing director John Zabriskie resigned from his position earlier this month.

Svanholm said that he respected Gyll's decision to leave his position as chief executive officer and president after five years, aged 57. He will be replaced by head of appliance maker Electrolux Leif Johansson.
